name: Goal-Gradient Effect
axiom: Effort rises as the goal nears; the last stretch gets the most.
trigger: People start slowly on a long task and speed up near its end.

checklist.text: Show how far the person has come, not only how much remains.
Split a long run into visible goals, so a near one is always in reach.
Put the last review beside the finish, where the end is in view.

antiPattern.violation: A ten-step setup shows one spinner for the whole run, so people leave at step three.
antiPattern.remediation: Show each completed step and the count remaining, so the goal stays in view.

parametricParams.caption: EFFORT RISES AS THE GOAL NEARS

academicOrigin.title: The Goal-Gradient Hypothesis Resurrected: Purchase Acceleration, Illusionary Goal Progress, and Customer Retention
